name: Flighty – Live Flight Tracker
subtitle: Live Flight Tracker
description:
"Don't Fly Without This App" WSJ • Finalist for App of The Year • Winner of Apple Design Award

The flight tracker your pilot uses.

Free trial does not required credit card.
No account required.
No newsletters.
No ads.

▶ WORLD'S FASTEST DELAY ALERTS
- 2-90 minutes faster than airline apps
- 24-48 hours faster cancellation alerts
- Always be the first to know, with no effort

▶ INDUSTRY-FIRST FEATURES
- See WHY you're flight is delayed
- 25-hour where's my plane
- Flighty Friends – private sharing among family/friends
- Pilot-Grade data – FAA and Eurocontrol
- Delay Predictions
- Gate Predictions
- Flighty Passport – auto-create your personal flight map
- Airport Intelligence – plain word summary of the status
- Taxi times
- Ground radar
- Proximity radar

▶ AUTOMATIONS
- Calendar sync
- TripIt sync
- Email forwarding
- Flighty Friends: private flight sharing with friends

▶ PILOT-GRADE DATA
- Live-streaming
- Actual flight plans
- Commercial data – same source used by your pilot
- FAA advisories, warnings, and delays
- Tail number – with birthday, type, and even name
- Full flight timetable
- Proximity radar - see flights around you
- Ground radar - radar even while taxiing

▶ BE THE FIRST TO KNOW
- Late arriving aircraft delays – up to 6 hours before your airline!
- Alerts for canceled inbound aircraft
- Alerts for airport weather or traffic
- Delay forecast

▶ ASSISTANTS
- Morning-Of Assistant - wake up informed
- Check In Assistant - your reservation number and check in link at the right time
- Connection Assistant - see all the checkpoints required for your connection and how long it typically takes
- Import Assistant - seamless import (plus data enrichment!) from myFlightradar24, App In The Air, OpenFlights.org, FlightMemory, Logmyflight, and JetLovers

▶ WORLDWIDE + LIVE + UNLIMITED
- Every airline
- Every flight
- 24/7/365 live global coverage

▶ FLIGHTY FRIENDS
- Often sharing with Family and Friends? Invite them to see your flights and never manually share again!
- Picking someone up, excited for a friend to visit, meeting a colleague? Share your live flight status with one tap.

▶ WHAT'S FREE?
- No ads
- Unlimited flights
- Flighty Friends
- Live data
- Weather
- Actual flight route
- Aircraft model and image
- Personal flight log and map
- Personal all-time and annual stats
- Apple Watch app
- iCloud backup & sync
- Historical flight input and import limited to past 365 days (due to costs)
- Lock screen widgets (limited refresh for costs)
- Airport Intelligence 

▶ WHAT'S PRO?
- See why your flight is delayed
- Pilot-grade FAA delay alerts
- Delay predictions, including the reason why
- Industry's fastest push alerts
- 25-hour where's my plane
- Live lock screen widgets
- Live data, even on 'messaging-only' plane wifi
- Live activities
- Unlimited past flight lookup
- Unlimited bulk import
- Delay predictions
- Arrival forecast
- TripIt sync
- Calendar sync
- Email forwarding
- Apple Watch complications
- Airport 
- Tail number
- Taxi times
- And more

Pro is free on your first flight. No trial required.

flightyapp.com/privacy Zero personal information is required. 
flightyapp.com/terms Personal use only. Business@flightyapp.com for business usage.
